Definition
[Regular boundary point] 1. ch8:8.75\group ch08-generalized-solutions A point $x_0\in \partial \Omega $ is regular for $L$ if every solution constructed from continuous boundary data and admissible $f^i,g$ converges to its prescribed boundary value as $x\to x_0$. The local density condition \begin{equation} \liminf _{R\downarrow 0}\frac{|B_R(x_0)\setminus \Omega |}{R^n}>0 \tag {8.75} \end{equation} is sufficient by the proof of Theorem 8.27.
